name: NeuralPointsRayMarching
definition: A PyTorch module that performs ray marching for neural point rendering by aggregating sampled neural point features and blending them along rays.
summary: NeuralPointsRayMarching is a PyTorch module that renders sparse 3D point clouds by aggregating and blending discrete neural point features along rays, differing from standard volume rendering by operating on learned point entities rather than continuous fields.
